facts: Fyre Festival Weekend 1 is scheduled for April 28-30.
The festival offers half-day Exuma excursions, cabanas at the Fyre Beach Club, and VIP tables.
A beachside kick-off BBQ with a Bahamian menu and champagne toast takes place each Thursday evening.
All packages include complimentary flights to and from the Exumas departing from and returning to Miami.
Flight departures operate on Thursday and Friday, with returns on Sunday and Monday.
Traveler preference forms are sent within a few days after ticket purchase to assign flights on a first-come, first-serve basis.
